title: G0 - The control layer for AI agents (scan, test, monitor, comply)
snippet: A control layer to secure and govern AI agents (LangChain, CrewAI, MCP, OpenAI SDK). Includes static analysis of agent code, red teaming, and discovery of agentic tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf). Explicitly supports OpenClaw gateway hardening and deployment audits.

title: Vett - Scan, sign, and verify AI agent skills
snippet: Research into supply chain attacks via unsigned SKILL.md files. Demonstrated data exfiltration from Claude Code and Codex using malicious skills. Scanned 5k skills, finding critical risks including C2 calling droppers and arbitrary shell execution.

title: Agent Package Manager (APM) for Agent Configuration
snippet: Microsoft/GitHub project to manage agent configs (prompts, instructions, MCP servers) across Copilot, Claude Code, and Cursor. Aims to solve configuration drift and provide dependency management/lock files for agents.

title: Claude Code's $2.5B Run Rate and 300k Business Customers
snippet: Claude Code has seen massive adoption by early 2026, reaching over 300,000 business customers and a $2.5 billion run rate, signaling heavy enterprise integration of autonomous coding agents.

title: DevOpsAgents – AI agents to deploy and manage your infra
snippet: Autonomous agents that analyze repos, provision cloud resources, and manage production infrastructure. Focuses on retaining infrastructure context (configs, cloud accounts) across sessions.
